help_a_no_advice: When the forecast's uncertainty band is too wide, the system refuses to guess rather than give a confident but wrong answer.
help_a_worst_case: It's the 1-in-10 outcome — only a 10% chance it's worse than this. The expected gain and the worst case are always shown at the same size.
help_a_grade: By answering six questions — size, colour, sprouting, damage %, moisture, foreign matter. No photo is needed.
help_a_pledge: No — it's an indicative simulation only, not a real loan. If the interest would exceed the gain, this card never shows at all.
help_a_escrow: The buyer's money sits in escrow before dispatch — it only reaches your account once delivery is confirmed.
help_q_pool: Will joining a pool hurt me?
help_a_pool: No — if any member's share would be worth less than selling alone, that pool simply does not form.
help_q_counter: How many times can I counter?
help_a_counter: Up to three rounds. After the third round, the counter option is disabled.
help_a_offline: The last data fetched is shown, marked as old — never a blank screen or an error where a number used to be.
help_a_model_reliable: The AI price model is trained on 5 years of APMC Lasalgaon data. It performs best when market conditions are stable.

nar_scr_phone: Say or type your ten digit mobile number. We will send a six digit code to it. We never ask for an Aadhaar number.
nar_scr_value: Krishi Mitr tells you three things. Today's real price, whether to sell today or wait, and how much you could gain or lose by waiting. Press next to continue.
nar_scr_model: This explains how the forecast is made. What data it uses, how old that data is, and how often the forecast has been right. When the forecast is too uncertain, we do not give advice.
nar_scr_pool: Your crop is sold together with other farmers' crop. A bigger lot fetches a better price. Each farmer is paid according to his share, and that calculation is shown here.
nar_scr_camera: Take a photo of your crop. In good light, from above, with the whole lot visible. A clear photo makes buyers offer more.
nar_scr_photo: Check whether this photo is clear. If not, take it again. This is the photo buyers will see.
nar_scr_qty: Tell us how much crop you have, in bags or quintals. This number must be right, because your gain is calculated from it.
nar_scr_radar: Your lot is now visible to buyers. You will be told as soon as someone bids. Until then there is nothing you need to do.
nar_scr_assistant: Ask me anything here, about prices, costs or a deal. If I do not know the answer I will say so rather than guess.
nar_scr_menu: From here you can change the language, see your own details, and sign out of the app.
nar_scr_profile: These are your details: name, village, district and mobile number. Press edit if you want to change anything.
nar_scr_talks: This shows your ongoing talks with buyers: what each offered, what you asked, and whose turn it is now. Talks waiting on your reply appear at the top.

splash_narration: Hello. This is Krishi Mitr. It tells you whether to sell today or wait. Speak to it in your own language — Marathi, Hindi or English — and it will listen and answer aloud. You do not need to read: every screen reads itself out. The voice works even with no internet. Press the Get Started button below to begin.
